raise_StageFailedException: raise a StageFailedException to signal that a processing stage has failed
raise_StageTimeoutException: raise a StageTimeoutException with a message and optional stage_cancelled flag
catch_StageTimeoutException: catch a StageTimeoutException and check its stage_cancelled attribute for recovery
raise_WaitValidStatusTimeout: raise a WaitValidStatusTimeout when waiting for a valid status exceeds the time limit
raise_NoServerIpsException: raise a NoServerIpsException when no server IP addresses are available
